description: Parameters fixed before the experiments of the paper. cazp: design of CAZP from the design study on training seeds 101-124 of configuration II (the coupling gain alpha is set by the tuning of each configuration and the bound cred by experiments.py; 'adapt': false switches off an option of the design study that the paper does not use; it is kept because the policy parameters form the run key). vsl_s and cv_speed_pacing: settings of VSL-S and CV speed pacing that the tuning grids vary. queue_discharge_II: queue discharge rate without control in configuration II from the design study (veh/h), used to scale the demands of configuration III.
